Use case: stylized-concept. Production fine PIXEL ART landscape sprite atlas for Taiwan pseudo-3D arcade driving game. Landscape 1536x1024. STRICT THREE HORIZONTAL ROWS, each one separate very wide panoramic mountain strip, approximately 1536x300, with 35px genuinely transparent gutter between rows. Alpha0 sky ABOVE each silhouette, opaque land below ending at a FLAT row baseline, strips do not overlap. No sky, clouds, road, cars, HUD, labels, buildings except where specified. Carefully crafted small square color clusters, crisp stepped contours, warm upper-left sun and deep cool shadows with visible detail. Fine painted pixel-art arcade style, not photo, not smooth painting, not random dithering noise, not coarse blocks. Natural varied ridgelines and diagonal slopes, NO vertically striped cliffs, NO level-topped enclosing wall. Layers have different silhouettes, valleys and varied depths.
Taiwan HEHUANSHAN alpine ridges. TOP ROW distant layered low pale blue-violet serrated ridges with large variation in peak heights. MIDDLE ROW gray-green rocky mountain shoulders, strong diagonal folds and golden-green Yushan arrow bamboo meadow. BOTTOM ROW nearer rolling grass ridge, irregular gray exposed rock outcrops, sparse low wind-shaped dwarf juniper and little alpine azalea. Broad curved slopes with shaded hollows and rock facets. No snow, no palms, no broadleaf forest, no buildings. Every row terrain fills from irregular upper skyline down to its flat baseline, never a vertical wall.
